title: Answer from the notification
tags: The joys of a Mac app

options.label: Blocked only, with my pick and a reply right in the notification
options.act: UNNotification with actions [rec pick, Open] + text input; time-sensitive for blocked only
options.then: Notify only when an agent is blocked, with my pick as a button and a reply field.

options.label: Blocked with actions, plus progress news for a project you're watching
options.act: Per-project Watch toggle enables milestone notifications

why: When an agent is blocked on you, and only then, the notification carries the question with my pick as a button ("Go with: Detect types"), Open, and a reply field for a note. That's Messages' inline reply and Calendar's Accept/Decline (UNNotificationAction plus a text-input action). It's marked time-sensitive, so it gets through a Focus only when it's blocking. Activity never notifies.

Flex's simulator separates progress news ("Scene 7 is in", with a thumbnail) from Needs you (the card plus my pick, which opens it). With several projects, progress news stays in the page, the menu bar and the Live Activity, and only Needs you reaches the notification centre, unless you're watching a project.
The agent gets the answer within seconds, and you never left what you were doing.
The same notification reaches your phone through Fuchi; see Away from the Mac.
